metadata.name: Webhook Trigger
metadata.summary: Generic inbound HTTP webhook trigger for Greentic flows
metadata.description: Ships the canonical webhook trigger nodeType plus three design-time tools (validate_webhook_config, suggest_path, infer_auth_from_curl). Webhook is operator-side ingress — the runtime exposes an HTTP listener, validates auth, and kicks off flow execution when a request matches the configured path. The tools help the designer LLM produce a valid trigger config from natural-language intent or a sample curl an upstream system would send.

nodeTypes.label: Webhook Trigger
nodeTypes.config_schema: {"type":"object","required":["method","path"],"properties":{"method":{"type":"string","enum":["GET","POST","PUT","PATCH"],"default":"POST","description":"HTTP method the webhook accepts"},"path":{"type":"string","description":"URL path the runtime listens on (e.g. /webhook/orders)","examples":["/webhook/orders","/hooks/slack-event","/api/intake"]},"auth":{"type":"object","description":"Authentication policy applied to incoming requests","properties":{"type":{"type":"string","enum":["none","bearer","hmac","basic"],"default":"none"},"secret_ref":{"type":"string","description":"Secret name holding the auth credential (for bearer / hmac / basic)"}}},"signature_validation":{"type":"object","description":"Optional HMAC signature check applied to the request body","properties":{"header":{"type":"string","examples":["X-Hub-Signature-256","X-Slack-Signature"]},"algorithm":{"type":"string","enum":["hmac-sha256","hmac-sha1"],"default":"hmac-sha256"},"secret_ref":{"type":"string","description":"Secret name holding the signing key"}}},"allowed_sources":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Optional CIDR allowlist for the request's source IP (e.g. \"203.0.113.0/24\")"}}}

tools.name: validate_webhook_config
tools.description: Validate a webhook trigger config block and return diagnostics. Checks that method is one of GET/POST/PUT/PATCH, that path is present, absolute and free of whitespace, '?' and '#', that auth.type is one of none/bearer/hmac/basic and carries a bare secret_ref when it is not "none", that any signature_validation block has a header, a secret_ref and a supported algorithm, and that every allowed_sources entry is a valid IP or CIDR.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"node":{"type":"object","description":"The webhook trigger node to validate. Only its \"config\" block is inspected.","properties":{"config":{"type":"object","properties":{"method":{"type":"string","enum":["GET","POST","PUT","PATCH"],"description":"Required. HTTP method the webhook accepts."},"path":{"type":"string","description":"Required. URL path the runtime listens on. Must start with '/' and contain no whitespace, '?' or '#'; a trailing slash is reported as a warning."},"auth":{"type":"object","properties":{"type":{"type":"string","enum":["none","bearer","hmac","basic"],"description":"Defaults to \"none\" when absent."},"secret_ref":{"type":"string","description":"Required unless type is \"none\". Bare secret name; a \"secret:\" prefix is reported as a warning."}},"additionalProperties":true},"signature_validation":{"type":"object","properties":{"header":{"type":"string","description":"Required when the block is present. Header carrying the signature."},"algorithm":{"type":"string","enum":["hmac-sha256","hmac-sha1"]},"secret_ref":{"type":"string","description":"Required when the block is present. Bare name of the signing-key secret."}},"additionalProperties":true},"allowed_sources":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Each entry must be a valid IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR block."}},"additionalProperties":true}},"additionalProperties":true}},"required":["node"]}

tools.name: suggest_path
tools.description: Slugify an intent string into a webhook path (e.g. "Receive Stripe events" -> "/webhooks/stripe-events"). Returns the path plus a rationale. An intent that is already an absolute path with no whitespace is passed through unchanged.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"intent":{"type":"string","description":"What the webhook receives, e.g. \"Receive Stripe events\". Non-alphanumeric characters become '-', filler words (receive, incoming, for, from, the, a, an, to, into) are dropped once the intent has more than two words, and the slug is placed under \"/webhooks/\". An intent that slugifies to nothing is an error."}},"required":["intent"]}

tools.name: infer_auth_from_curl
tools.description: Infer the inbound webhook auth shape (bearer/basic/hmac) from a sample curl that an upstream system would send to the webhook endpoint. Returns a suggested_config with method, path, auth and — when a signature header is present — signature_validation, plus a rationale. Falls back to auth.type "none" when no auth or signature header is found.
tools.input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"curl_cmd":{"type":"string","description":"A sample curl the upstream system would send INTO the webhook, e.g. \"curl -X POST https://host/webhooks/stripe -H 'Stripe-Signature: t=1,v1=abc'\". The method comes from -X/--request (default POST), the path from the URL, and the auth shape from the Authorization and signature headers."}},"required":["curl_cmd"]}
